name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=render, descriptor=save_slot_grid). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects behavior: renders the 4-slot SAVE-slot selection grid (per-slot 'Slot N' header + chapter intro icon/title or EMPTY sentinel, selected slot in highlight border glyph).
purpose: Render the 4-slot save-slot grid: for each of slots 0..3 draw a 'Slot N' header plus either the chapter intro-icon + chapter title (from the slot's stored chapter id) or an 'EMPTY' sentinel sprite, with the currently-highlighted slot drawn in a distinct border glyph.
logic_summary: Loops slot_iter 0..3. slot_base = sav_decrypted_buf + 0x312B + slot_iter*0xA28 (SAV header 0x312B, per-slot stride 0xA28). border_glyph = (slot_iter==highlight_slot) ? 0xC9 : 0xCD. Writes data_fd2_dialog_last_action_value_param (@0x53AE1) = slot_iter+1 (1-indexed slot number consumed by the dialog text formatter's literal-number op). row_off = surface_offset + (slot_iter*0x13 + 0x77)*0x140 (0x140 = 320-byte VGA row pitch). Renders 'Slot N' header sprite 0x225 at row_off+0xA. Reads chapter_id = slot_base[0xA00]; if 0xFF (empty) the shared tail call renders 'EMPTY' sprite 0x202 at row_off+0x58; otherwise renders chapter intro icon (sprite chapter_id+0x202) at row_off+0x28 and the shared tail call renders the chapter title (sprite chapter_id+0x226) at row_off+0x82. All three dialog draws go through fd2_display_dialog_scene(all_game_text, page, pos, 0x140, border_glyph, 0x4C, 0,0,0). Compiler-injected __CHK(0x38) stack-probe prologue.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_save_slot_grid(uint32 highlight_slot, uint32 surface_offset, uint8 *sav_decrypted_buf)

params.name: highlight_slot
params.semantics: Index (0..3) of the currently-selected slot; the slot whose slot_iter equals this value is drawn with the highlight border glyph 0xC9 (others 0xCD). Caller passes the live cursor index from fd2_save_slot_selector_ui.
params.reason: Source-level name already descriptive and address-free; matches its sole use (border-glyph selection comparison).

params.name: surface_offset
params.semantics: Base byte offset into the compose-target surface; added into per-row row_off to position each slot's text/sprites. Passed by the caller as the compose target surface.
params.reason: Source-level name already descriptive and address-free; matches use as the row_off base.

params.name: sav_decrypted_buf
params.semantics: Pointer to the decrypted FD2.SAV buffer; indexed at +0x312B + slot_iter*0xA28 + 0xA00 to read each slot's stored chapter id (0xFF = empty). Passed by the caller.
params.reason: Source-level name already descriptive and address-free; matches use as the decrypted SAV source for per-slot chapter id.

returns.semantics: No return value; renders directly into the compose surface and writes the dialog literal-number global as a side effect.

reads_globals: data_fd2_all_game_text_ptr (0x53A7D) -- FDTXT.DAT source for 'Slot N' + chapter title strings; passed as the first arg to fd2_display_dialog_scene.
writes_globals: data_fd2_dialog_last_action_value_param (0x53AE1) -- set to slot_iter+1 each iteration; the 1-indexed slot number consumed by the dialog text formatter's literal-number op.
